text: An Nulaaɗo, maakan ɓee sirkooɓe : "Hara no e kafidiiɓe mon ɓen ɓe rewoton gaanin Alla on mo no fuɗɗa tagu mo alah yeru adiido refti o ruttita ngu ɓaawo maayde?" Maakan ɓe : "Alla kan no fuɗɗira tagu ngun no woowiraaka refti O immintina ngu ɓaawo maayde maggu. Ko honno fefindira ɗon, onon ɓee sirkooɓe, ittaɗon e goona faade e meere?
